entries.requirement: Label or store every scripted, simulated, smoke or bot visit so it can never count as a visitor or conversion; after a run, a read-only query shows zero external rows from it.
entries.why: Measured on QuickLease 2026-10-22..25 (conversion intelligence mission): see the origin line under the rule.

origin.quote: CONV-01 Every scripted, simulated, smoke, bot or twin visit must be stored or labelled so it can never be counted as a visitor or a conversion, and a read-only query after the run must show zero external rows from it.

entries.requirement: Before optimizing a landing page for a traffic source, prove that source reaches the first funnel event: a tagged visit is recorded (positive) and a bot visit is not (negative).
entries.why: Measured on QuickLease 2026-10-22..25 (conversion intelligence mission): see the origin line under the rule.

origin.quote: CONV-02 Before optimizing a landing page for a traffic source, prove that source reaches the first funnel event, with a positive control (a tagged visit is recorded) and a negative control (an untagged or bot visit is not).

entries.requirement: Count a paid conversion only from the payment processor's server event (webhook), never from a success-page visit or client event; keep the case record joined to it.
entries.why: Measured on QuickLease 2026-10-22..25 (conversion intelligence mission): see the origin line under the rule.

origin.quote: CONV-03 Count a paid conversion only from the payment processor's server event (webhook), never from a success-page visit or a client event, and keep the case record joined to it.

entries.requirement: Report a conversion rate, lift or forecast only above a declared minimum sample; below it say INCONCLUSIVE plus the sample and minimum detectable effect still needed.
entries.why: Measured on QuickLease 2026-10-22..25 (conversion intelligence mission): see the origin line under the rule.

origin.quote: CONV-04 Report a conversion rate, lift or forecast only above a declared minimum sample; below it the answer is INCONCLUSIVE together with the sample size and minimum detectable effect still needed, never a precise percentage.

entries.requirement: Before dividing one funnel count by another, name the page that emits each event; visitors-to-starts is a page-to-form rate only if the entry event fires on that page.
entries.why: Measured on QuickLease 2026-10-22..25 (conversion intelligence mission): see the origin line under the rule.

origin.quote: CONV-05 A ratio such as visitors to starts is a page-to-form rate only if the entry event is emitted on that page; name the page that emits each event before dividing one count by another.

entries.requirement: Test a 'price reduces conversion' hypothesis only on visitors who saw the price: first measure where the price is shown and how many visitors reached that point.

origin.quote: CONV-06 A hypothesis that price reduces conversion is testable only on visitors who saw the price; first measure where the price is shown and how many visitors reached that point.

entries.requirement: A text-presence check claiming a page answers a visitor question needs golden tests, including a sentence that defers or negates the answer.

origin.quote: CONV-07 A text-presence check that says a page answers a visitor question must carry golden tests, including a sentence that defers or negates the answer, so neither a false present nor a false missing passes.
